data.name: Kathir
data.gender_notes: Kathir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kathir is an Arabic name that means 'abundant' or 'plentiful', signifying someone who is generous and giving. It is a name that reflects a person's character and their willingness to share their resources with others. The name Kathir carries the meaning “Abundant, Plentiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kathir usually hope their child will grow to embody abundant, plentiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the concept of abundance is closely tied to the idea of gratitude and contentment.
data.etymology: Kathir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Abundant, Plentiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kathir total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: كثير
in_arabic.long_meaning: كثير هو اسم عربي يعني الوافر أو الغني، مستمد من الجذر العربي ك-ث-ر، الذي يشير إلى الوفرة والكثرة، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في التراث الإسلامي لوصف الله تعالى بصفات الكرم والإعطاء

in_urdu.name: کثیر
in_urdu.meaning: کثیر کا مطلب بہت یا زیادہ ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: کثیر ایک عربی نام ہے جو بہت یا زیادہ کے معنی میں ہے، جس کا ماخذ عربی جڑ ک-ث-ر سے ہے، جو کثرت اور بھرپور کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے، اور یہ نام برصغیر کے مسلمانوں میں بہت مقبول ہے

in_hindi.name: कथिर
in_hindi.meaning: कथिर का अर्थ होता है बहुत या अधिक
in_hindi.long_meaning: कथिर एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ बहुत या अधिक होता है, जो अरबी मूल क-थ-र से लिया गया है, जो बहुतायत और समृद्धि की ओर संकेत करता है, और यह नाम भारतीय मुसलमानों में बहुत लोकप्रिय है

in_pashto.name: کثیر
